says: Alice answers the WAL-or-rollback conflict with WAL and keep-until-change; the application_preference the owner records is active, and the record her verified answer selects (WAL) is a participant its list marks applicable. The WAL choice is then withdrawn. When the application is recorded again for the same answer, the owner does not write an active preference whose selected record is no longer applicable: it writes the preference invalidated because a participant changed, with WAL kept as an ended participant (withdrawn, not applicable) and the rollback choice still live.
